overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that checking if price <= average * (1.0 - stop_pct) would trigger a stop-loss when the position is down 30%, but it used the wrong comparison operator.
why_it_breaks: With stop_loss_pct configured as 0.20 (20%), the condition price <= average * (1.0 - 0.20) triggers only when price <= average * 0.80, meaning the position must be down 20% or more. However, AAA was down 30% (price = average * 0.70), which satisfies 0.70 <= 0.80, so the stop should have triggered. The bug must be elsewhere in the execution path - likely the stop-loss order was generated but then rejected by a different gate (thesis-change, cooldown, or minimum trade size) that the agent added as part of the anti-churn fixes, blocking even hard-trigger stops.
